The matching shell reload cover and boot screen live at https://github.com/CratusGod/Oneshot-themed-Ryoku.

lockscreens.name: Nothing Interface
lockscreens.author: Ivan <254410104+venchik111@users.noreply.github.com>
lockscreens.summary: Dot clock and live Ryoku status over your current wallpaper.
lockscreens.description: A Nothing OS-inspired lockscreen with a dot clock, battery, daily screen time and MPRIS media controls. Uses the current Ryogami wallpaper during a locked session; no wallpaper is bundled.

lockscreens.name: Kitsune
lockscreens.author: 0xSrcAura
lockscreens.summary: Ase, the seven-tailed kitsune, and her seven tarot folds at the door.
lockscreens.description: The Jurai lock, carried to the store whole: Ase, the seven-tailed kitsune, drawn in shaders and light, and her seven tarot folds. Typing binds the folds one by one, each whispered as it lands — THE EYE · TRUTH, THE PHANTOM · POWER, THE BLADE · WISDOM, THE SAGE · JUDGMENT, THE SHROUD · LIFE, THE FORGE · LOVE, THE MIRROR · DISCIPLINE. At seven the Cast rises: INVOKE THE SEAL. A wrong key hurts her and scatters the cards; the true key transforms her and opens the seal. Built in 2026 for Jurai shell; the store port preserves her scene and shaders while welcoming the selected account.

lockscreens.name: 43PR Monochrome
lockscreens.author: 43PR (Ryoku adaptation by Sipper1236)
lockscreens.summary: Centered clock and outlined password capsule
lockscreens.description: A visual adaptation of the 43PR Hyprlock layout for qylock: monochrome clock, date and outlined password input. Authentication stays in the native host. Solid dark backdrop; no desktop capture, external artwork or media polling.
